title: Checkpoint: mmap Line Counter
prompt: POSIX. Implement `long count_lines_mmap(const char *path)` — open, fstat, mmap PROT_READ MAP_PRIVATE, count newline bytes, munmap, close; return the count. Empty file returns 0. Any failure (open/fstat/mmap) returns -1. A trailing newline produces no extra phantom line beyond the newlines actually counted.

tests.name: counts newlines
tests.hint: Seven newline-terminated records: seven newlines counted through the mapping.

tests.name: empty file is zero
tests.hint: Zero bytes map to nothing to count: 0, not an error.

tests.name: missing file fails
tests.hint: A path that cannot be opened returns -1 — failures must be visible.
